items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Frank Wes was in that band and, of course I mentioned Fats.

ctx.x: Now did you tour with that band?

No, I just did the Cotton Club with them in New York. It was just one engagement. I think Frank Wes was in that band and, of course I mentioned Fats. That was one of the funniest things I have ever seen in my life. It was him falling through the floor.
Now, tell that story because I think we were all off and the tape wasn't running when he told that.
